_schema: Collection-mode source of truth. Coordinates: goal-mouth x = kicker's right (+) / left (-) of goal center (m), y = ball-center height (m). Spot lateral_m = ball offset from the goal's center line (+ = kicker's right). Envelope fields are [min, max]; omitted = no data. curl_m = signed max deviation from the straight chord ball->goal entry (+ = path bulges to the kicker's right). wall_plane_height_m = ball-center height crossing the 9.15 m wall plane (1.8 m wall + ball radius => >= 1.95 to clear a standing wall). Confidence: measured (published analysis), broadcast_estimate (commentary/press figures), derived (inferred from descriptions/geometry, needs footage review).

kicks.title: Hat-trick equaliser
kicks.match: Portugal 3-3 Spain, World Cup group stage, Sochi
kicks.technique: instep curl over the wall (not his knuckle)
sources: Shankara 2018, Analysis of Cristiano Ronaldo's Free Kick using CFD, icSPORTS extended abstracts pp.40-43: 22 m, 26.8 m/s, ~5 rev/s, 0.82 s flight, ~3.5 m deflection from launch line, ball hits net ~5.9 m from the (kicker's) left post. https://www.scitepress.org/Papers/2018/72360/72360.pdf
FIFA: World Cup wonder goals - Cristiano Ronaldo v Spain (2018)
kicks.notes: The paper's 26.8 m/s equals 22 m / 0.82 s, i.e. most likely the mean speed; launch speed must be higher under drag, so the speed range starts at the mean and is capped at a generous 34 m/s. 3.5 m is deflection from the launch line; chord sagitta of a circular arc is ~1/4 of that (~0.9 m), hence curl_m. Spin ~31 rad/s. Lateral spot position not given (0 assumed). Entry side inferred from right-foot instep curl that 'curves away from the goal initially before curving back'.

kicks.title: The banana shot
kicks.match: France 1-1 Brazil, Tournoi de France, Lyon
sources: Dupeux, Le Goff, Quere, Clanet 2010, The spinning ball spiral, New J. Phys. 12 093004 (via Physics World: ~35 m, spiral needs the long distance, cleared the wall by at least 1 m, entered at the right-hand post). https://physicsworld.com/a/brazilian-wondergoal-was-no-fl/
Press speed estimates range 105-137 km/h (29-38 m/s); not from a measurement.
kicks.notes: Left-foot outside strike: launched right of the wall, bends left, in off the inside of the kicker's-right post. Height at entry unclear in sources (post, low-to-mid). Lateral spot offset is an estimate. Physically depends on drag growth as the ball slows (spiral) - a constant-Cd model may not reproduce the late bend.

kicks.title: The knuckleball
kicks.match: Manchester United 2-0 Portsmouth, Premier League, Old Trafford
sources: 90min, Anatomy of a goal: 25-yard effort, knuckleball into the top-right corner past David James.
Speed widely quoted ~136 km/h (37.8 m/s); press figure, not a published measurement.
kicks.notes: 25 yards = 22.9 m. Lateral spot position not given.

kicks.title: Kahn beaten from distance
kicks.match: Bayern Munich 1-2 Lyon, Champions League group stage, Olympiastadion
sources: UEFA, The best free kicks in Champions League history; Juninho: 'my best knuckleball free-kick from a long distance'. Roughly 35 yards (~32 m); in off the inside of Kahn's left-hand post (kicker's right).
kicks.notes: 'Flew high, looked over, dipped late' - wall-plane height range reflects that description. Exact date/entry height need footage review.

kicks.title: 600th Barcelona goal
kicks.match: Barcelona 3-0 Liverpool, Champions League semi-final 1st leg, Camp Nou
kicks.technique: instep curl over the wall into the top corner
sources: Sports Illustrated / UEFA: curled into the top corner from ~25-30 yards; UEFA Goal of the Season 2018/19.
kicks.notes: Entry side (x) deliberately omitted until confirmed from footage.

kicks.title: Power and dip at the Euros
kicks.match: England 2-1 Wales, Euro 2016 group stage, Lens
kicks.technique: driven knuckle/dip (Bale: deliberately more power and dip than curl)
sources: Sports Illustrated: 35-yard knuckling free kick; Hart got hands to it diving toward his left post (kicker's right).
Sky Sports: Bale on altering his free-kick style for power and dip.
kicks.notes: Keeper got a touch - the goal-entry point is after the touch in real life; envelope uses pre-touch target.

kicks.title: Under the wall
kicks.match: Barcelona 2-0 Werder Bremen, Champions League group stage, Camp Nou
kicks.technique: placed low under a jumping wall
sources: UEFA match report 'Barcelona break Bremen hearts': 13th-minute free kick from the edge of the area, under the wall into the bottom corner.
ESPN, Behind the wall: how Ronaldinho's free kicks helped spark the lie-down-behind-the-wall trend.
kicks.notes: Only replicable if the wall jumps (FreeKickSandbox wall jumps are seeded and start at set piece 30) and if a low/skidding ball is allowed - BallFlightSimulator stops at first ground contact.

kicks.title: Celtic Park top corner
kicks.match: Celtic 1-0 Manchester United, Champions League group stage, Celtic Park
sources: UEFA 'Celtic marvel made in Japan': 25-metre free kick into the top corner.
SPORTbible: 30 yards, past a full-stretch Van der Sar into the top corner.
kicks.notes: Distance sources disagree (25 m vs 27.4 m); 26 m used. Entry side omitted until footage review.

kicks.title: Wembley extra-time winner
kicks.match: Barcelona 1-0 Sampdoria (a.e.t.), European Cup final, Wembley
sources: Wikipedia, 1992 European Cup final: 112th-minute free kick, ~25 yards.
Champions Journal, How Koeman's thunderbolt sparked Barcelona into life.
kicks.notes: Envelope empty on purpose: height/side/speed need footage review. Kept in the pilot as the 'driven power' archetype.

kicks.title: 93rd-minute qualifier
kicks.match: England 2-2 Greece, World Cup qualifier, Old Trafford
kicks.technique: instep curl up and over the wall into the far corner
sources: Planet Football, An ode to David Beckham vs Greece: ~30 yards, up and over the wall, curled into the far corner (93rd minute).
kicks.notes: 30 yards = 27.4 m. Far corner for a right-foot curl = kicker's left. Lateral spot offset unknown.
